name: Comet ML
tagline: Comet is an MLOps platform that provides experiment tracking, model registry, and production monitoring for machine learning teams. It integrates with popular ML frameworks to log metrics, hyperparameters, and artifacts, enabling reproducibility and collaboration across data science teams.
